headline: Fishermen Tie Up Their Boats: 'In Three Years You Won't Eat Greek Fish, We Are Heading for Disaster' (video)
summary: Fishermen began a work stoppage demanding urgent solutions to a sharp rise in fuel costs and other sector problems. As part of the protest, they are closing fish markets.
why: Fuel is a major operating cost for fishing fleets, so fuel price spikes directly squeeze margins and can disrupt local seafood supply.
